metaDescription: Shopify store for Bagallery, a multi-brand beauty and lifestyle retailer in Pakistan: makeup, skincare, haircare and fashion, with brand pages and filters.
summary: Shopify store for a multi-brand beauty, skincare and lifestyle retailer in Pakistan.
overview: Bagallery is a multi-brand retailer selling makeup, skincare, haircare, fragrance, fashion and lifestyle products from local and international brands, and it states that its products are 100% authentic. We built Bagallery's Shopify store to carry a large catalog from many brands alongside its own Home.Co line.
challenge: A multi-brand beauty store has to serve shoppers who arrive looking for a brand, a category or a deal. It also runs frequent sale campaigns with promo codes and payment partner discounts that need to be visible without burying the products.
approach: The header pairs a search bar with two menu rows: Beauty, Fashion, Vybe and Track your order, then Makeup, Skincare, Haircare, Lifestyle, Brands and Gen-Z. Collection pages have a product type filter sidebar, sorting and grid view options, with discount badges and a pay-with-Yeylo price on each card. Product pages show SKU, star rating, trust points for authenticity, 7-day returns and cash on delivery, an estimated delivery window and a Yeylo pay-in-3 option under Add to bag.
outcome: A Shopify store where shoppers can browse by brand or category, see the current deal on every product and check delivery dates and payment options before they add to bag.

process.title: Brands and categories
process.body: Two menu rows separate departments such as Beauty and Fashion from categories such as Makeup, Skincare and Haircare, with a Brands entry for shoppers who already know what they want.

process.title: Collections
process.body: Collection pages list product types in a filter sidebar, with sorting, grid density options, discount badges and a payment partner price strip on each card.

process.title: Product pages
process.body: Each product shows SKU, rating and review count, trust points for authenticity, returns and cash on delivery, a wish list button and an order-by countdown with estimated delivery dates.

process.title: Campaigns and mobile
process.body: A top banner explains stacked promo codes, and the mobile home page adds round category shortcuts, offer tiles and bestseller carousels for quick browsing.

whyItMatters: Multi-brand beauty shoppers compare brands, prices and delivery before they commit. A store that shows authenticity, returns and delivery dates on every product page answers those questions before checkout.

faqs.q: What platform is the Bagallery store built on?
faqs.a: It runs on Shopify with the Kalles theme, using Shopify collections for brands, beauty categories, lifestyle lines and sale campaigns.

faqs.q: Can Pixel2Tech build a similar Shopify store for my brand?
faqs.a: Yes. We design and build Shopify stores for multi-brand retailers, including brand navigation, product filters and campaign banners. Tell us about your catalog and we will send a fixed quote after a short call.
